title: Empty-state buttons overflow on small screens
symptom: The "no results" recovery buttons were laid out as a fixed three-column row. On phones and small tablets the centred row of three buttons is wider than the empty-state box, so it spills out on both sides: the first button is cut off past the left edge of the screen (where it cannot be scrolled to) and the last one past the right edge.
css: .empty__actions { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, max-content); justify-content: center; }
